purpose: Experiment E-FND-0177 in the foundations arena: a pre-registered survey of the candidate rule discrete choices, partial: of 144 variants (5 coins, the in-ring angle and 4 split primes at two exponents, 1 to 3 beat schedules, with and without the Cl+(4) register) 94 hold R = tan m / m to 1e-3 and $K^2$ isotropy to 1e-6, every coin among them, and only 26 keep the held-out one light speed: the swap coin (one beat at every mass, two and three beats at the light masses) and the register; no score prefers the prime 7, and the schedule defect hides under 1e-3 below m 0.05.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
